blocks.task_summary: Find the volume of the solid formed by rotating the region enclosed by x^2 + y^4 = r^4 (0 ≤ x ≤ r^2) and the y-axis about the y-axis, expressing it as V = aπr^b with a, b ∈ ℚ+.
method_path: Set up volume integral V = π ∫ x^2 dy from y = -r to y = r
Evaluate antiderivative π[r^4 y - y^5/5] from -r to r
Substitute limits and simplify to (8π/5) r^5
accepted_alternatives: Use symmetry: V = 2π ∫_0^r (r^4 - y^4) dy, leading to same result.

evidence.basis: x^2 = r^4 - y^4 (A1); substituting into π∫x^2 dy (M1); π∫(r^4 - y^4) dy from -r to r OR 2π∫_0^r (r^4 - y^4) dy (A1); antiderivative π[r^4 y - y^5/5] (A1); evaluating limits (A1); final answer 8πr^5/5 (A1).
